description: This file implements the BaseOutputTransport class for Pipecat, handling audio/video output processing, buffering, mixing, timing, media streaming, and interruption handling. It defines methods for starting/stopping transport, processing frames, managing media senders, and handling audio/video frames.

classes.name: BaseOutputTransport
classes.description: A base class for output transport implementations managing audio/video processing, buffering, timing, and media streaming.

classes.name: BaseOutputTransport.MediaSender
classes.description: Handles media streaming for a specific destination, managing buffering, timing, mixing, and frame delivery.

methods.name: start
methods.description: Initializes and starts the media sender, setting up tasks and mixers.

methods.name: stop
methods.description: Stops the media sender and cleans up resources.

methods.name: cancel
methods.description: Cancels all processing immediately.

methods.name: handle_interruptions
methods.description: Handles interruption events by restarting tasks and clearing buffers.

methods.name: handle_audio_frame
methods.description: Processes incoming audio frames, resampling and buffering.

methods.name: handle_image_frame
methods.description: Processes incoming image frames for video output.

methods.name: handle_timed_frame
methods.description: Handles frames with presentation timestamps.

methods.name: handle_sync_frame
methods.description: Processes frames requiring synchronized processing.

methods.name: handle_mixer_control_frame
methods.description: Processes audio mixer control frames.

methods.name: _create_audio_task
methods.description: Creates the audio processing task.

methods.name: _cancel_audio_task
methods.description: Cancels the audio processing task.

methods.name: _bot_started_speaking
methods.description: Handles event when bot starts speaking.

methods.name: _bot_stopped_speaking
methods.description: Handles event when bot stops speaking.

methods.name: _bot_currently_speaking
methods.description: Handles ongoing bot speaking event.

methods.name: _maybe_bot_currently_speaking
methods.description: Determines if bot is speaking based on audio silence.

methods.name: _handle_bot_speech
methods.description: Handles bot speech frames, including TTS and speech stream.

methods.name: _next_frame
methods.description: Generator for the next audio frame, with or without mixer.

methods.name: _send_silence
methods.description: Sends silence audio for a specified duration.

methods.name: _audio_task_handler
methods.description: Main handler for processing audio frames asynchronously.

methods.name: _create_video_task
methods.description: Creates the video processing task.

methods.name: _cancel_video_task
methods.description: Cancels the video processing task.

methods.name: _set_video_image
methods.description: Sets a single image for cycling in video output.

methods.name: _set_video_images
methods.description: Sets multiple images for cycling in video output.

methods.name: _video_task_handler
methods.description: Main handler for processing video frames.

methods.name: _video_is_live_handler
methods.description: Handles live video streaming with frame timing.

methods.name: _draw_image
methods.description: Resizes and renders an image frame.

methods.name: _create_clock_task
methods.description: Creates the clock/timing processing task.

methods.name: _cancel_clock_task
methods.description: Cancels the clock/timing task.

methods.name: _clock_task_handler
methods.description: Handles timed frame delivery based on presentation timestamps.
